description: Global dataset of heat wave types based on multi-level atmospheric temperature anomalies is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Ondřej Lhotka et al. Heat waves’ processes in the tropospheric column and their vertical structure have attracted growing attention recently, but data-demanding continental or global analyses remain rare. Here we present HW3D, a global dataset designed to classify heat waves according to their vertical temperature structure. Coverage: global; published in 2026. The formats are not stated in the sources read. The data are held in Mendeley Data and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support multi-sector infrastructure risk and planning studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
